evidence: The density of the STO layers as deposited and annealed at 600°C was evaluated as a function of the composition. The density of the as-deposited films was close to 85% of the bulk density: an increase in density for the compositions closer to stoichiometric SrTiO3 up to 96% of bulk (standard value of 5.122 g/cm3) was observed. The refractive index (measured by ellipsometry at the wavelength of 633 nm) is constant as a function of composition and ranges between 1.83 and 1.85 (±0.02). After the crystallization anneal, the refractive indexes increase, i.e., the highest values (±2.3 to 2.4) correspond to the films closest to the stoichiometric composition (Fig. 10), in agreement with the value of n633 = 2.389 reported for bulk SrTiO3. Surface roughness was determined by AFM measurements for 4:3 and 4:1 STO (6–7 nm), SrO (3 nm), and TiO2 (7 nm). The root-mean-square (rms) values of 0.15–0.21 corresponding to an rms/thickness between 3 and 5% are found (Table II).
